note: Known sermon series. The YouTube sync uses this to sort messages into series and to strip boilerplate out of titles, because the video titles spell things inconsistently. Add a new series when one starts.

howto.name: The series name as it should read on the website.
howto.subtitle: The long strap-line the church repeats in every video title for this series. It is stripped out so the sermon's own title is what shows.
howto.aliases: Any misspelling or variant that has gone out on YouTube.

excludedVideoIdsNote: Recordings verified not to contain a sermon. xdyz85AuiSY is a worship-team rehearsal that was uploaded with a sermon-style title.
notSermonsNote: Titles matching any of these are not treated as sermons and never reach the website. A plain entry is matched as a substring; an entry beginning 're:' is a regular expression. Do not exclude a recording merely because its title says worship, service, or livestream: older full-service recordings often contain the only available copy of the sermon. Use excludedVideoIds only after checking the recording itself.
